title: Star schema in data warehousing
topic: what a star schema is in data warehousing
persona_summary: Student has never heard the term 'star schema' before. They know basic SQL tables but no warehousing concepts. Goal: see the tutor scaffold from prerequisites without giving away the definition.
turns: I have no idea what a star schema is. Never heard the term before.
I know what a regular SQL table is, with rows and columns.
Wait, why would you organize tables in a special shape like a star?
So is it about putting one big table in the middle and others around it?
Hmm, I think the middle one would have the numeric data we want to analyze.
